messages:
sasha: FYI — Nexera's procurement replied: they will not accept any invoice until we're fully onboarded in their ERP and they have issued a formal PO referencing our vendor code. They also want e-invoice XML (Ariba/UBL) attached. Can billing pause issuance?
rachel: Ack. Do we have their vendor setup request / vendor code yet?
kevin: Not yet. I asked the Nexera buyer for the vendor setup form yesterday. They said their procurement team only creates the PO after vendor is in their system. Classic loop.
sasha: They sent a requirements PDF. Key bits: vendor_code, tax_id, bank SWIFT/IBAN, and a special "cost_center" tag in the invoice XML. Example snippet they expect:```<Invoice>...<Supplier><ID>V-12345</ID>...<TaxID>DE123456789</TaxID>...<CostCenter>CC-9876</CostCenter>```
lisa: Can we send a provisional proforma so they can trigger vendor onboarding while we await the PO? Or do they insist on final invoice only?
kevin: Buyer said only a PO will trigger their AP — proforma won't help for them. They need our legal name + vendor code to create vendor and then issue PO.
rachel: Ok — I'll flag billing to hold issuing final invoice. finance-bot: HOLD flag set on customer:nexera_labs — no invoices to be sent until vendor_code is provided. (automated note)
sasha: Sales please escalate with the buyer for vendor code and ask for a one-time "temporary vendor code" if possible. If procurement insists on signed SOW + vendor form, we may need AM to expedite.
kevin: Pinging @account-management for escalation. Also requesting buyer to confirm whether VAT reverse-charge applies (they're EU). If VAT details differ we need that before PO creation.
lisa: Noted. I'll prepare a checklist for vendor onboarding (W-9 / EU VAT cert / bank details / contact person) and drop it to the thread for Sales to forward.
rachel: Thanks — billing holding. Please update here once vendor code or PO# comes through. :white_check_mark:
